title: Perimeter of a shape
hints: Write one `match` case per constructor. Each case names the data it carries, like `Rect (w, h)`.
A circle's perimeter is `2.0 *. Float.pi *. r`. A rectangle's is `2.0 *. (w +. h)`. A square with side `a` has four sides.
Remember the dots: floats use `+.` and `*.`, and the literal `2` must be written `2.0`.
explain: The reference matches on the shape: `Circle r -> 2.0 *. Float.pi *. r`, `Rect (w, h) -> 2.0 *. (w +. h)`, `Square a -> 4.0 *. a`. Every case returns a float, so every number in it uses the dotted operators.
